title: Multi-project schedule meeting notes

messages.content: Meeting notes: 1) Mnemos benchmark refresh: owner Liang, deadline Jun 18, target LongMemEval +15 points over v7.12 mock baseline. 2) Token Optimizer v3: owner Chen, deadline Jun 25, decision: do not add LLM dependency before real-world benchmark reaches 30 cases. 3) Unfaze iOS latency: owner Ana, deadline Jul 2, target p95 < 650ms for zh-CN→en-US streaming. Budget: Mnemos $1,200, Token Optimizer $900, Unfaze $2,400. Risk: App Store review may delay Unfaze by 5-7 days.
Three tracks: Mnemos Jun 18 Liang, Token Optimizer Jun 25 Chen, Unfaze Jul 2 Ana. Total budget $4,500. Main risk: App Store review delay 5-7 days.
Add dependency: Token Optimizer v3 benchmark must finish before semantic compressor design starts.

notes: Tests multi-owner schedules, budget totals, latency target, and dependency rules.
